title: Hunts FH-032: Build route health and aggregate views

source.ref: Frequency Hunts Build Plan (9 Nov 2026), Tier 3, Collective. Owner asked 2026-11-09 to build the program into the site.

detail: Show stall points, alternate use, approved merchant metrics, open/closed placements and broadcast status. Done when: Organizer views route aggregates while partners cannot reconstruct participant trails. Requires: FH-025, FH-026, FH-029, FH-031. Owner role: Operations and analytics.
